calc.name: 分档
calc.expr: if(R==1 or R<=ceil(skill/20),'大成功', if(R>=96,'大失败', if(L=='limit', if(R<=floor(skill/10),'极限成功','失败'), if(L=='extreme', if(R<=floor(skill/5),'极难成功','失败'), if(L=='hard', if(R<=floor(skill/2),'困难成功','失败'), if(R<=floor(skill/5),'极难成功', if(R<=floor(skill/2),'困难成功', if(R<=skill,'成功','失败'))))))))
